rubric_items.reason: Every design component is in the source: the shared lastDays rule, DashboardService reuse, countByDoctor, the DoctorService fields and the page link. One gap: the web test that checks the exact link URL, which the design names, is deferred.

Each file sits in the layer the code-layout convention gives it: helper in api/src/lib, SQL in repositories, rules in services. SQL uses bind parameters only, and unknown ids still return 404 through notFound.
Only 7 files changed, all named by the design or needed for the types. The diff is 58 lines added and 5 deleted, and gates H1-H7 plus GEN-SIZE-01 pass.
The 404 check runs before the count. The count falls back to 0 when no row comes back, and the link renders for 0 too. The query string is built with URLSearchParams.

The summary and file list match the source I checked: periods.ts, dashboardService.ts, doctorService.ts, countByDoctor, both DoctorDetail types, DoctorDetailPage and fromDoctor. Both dashboard tests it names exist.

findings.text: The design says a web test asserts the exact link URL, because a misspelt doctorId would silently drop the filter. The change adds no tests and leaves the link URL to a later unit-test step. It says so openly.

cites.quote: The web test for the link asserts the exact URL.
no tests were added here. The count, the link URL and the window edges are left to the unit-test step.
